name: CURATO-OPIOID
description: This deposit contains the curated bioactivity data, the versioned pharmacology and assay-readout ontology, and the reference benchmark implementation for the study "Pharmacological Stratification of Public Bioactivity Databases: A Reusable, OECD-Anchored Curation and Benchmarking Framework Demonstrated for Opioid Receptors" (accepted in Digital Discovery, 2026; DOI: 10.1039/D6DD00392C). Records for the four human opioid receptors (MOR, DOR, KOR and NOP) were retrieved from ChEMBL, BindingDB, PubChem and the IUPHAR/BPS Guide to Pharmacology, reconciled across sources, standardized chemically, and stratified by pharmacology class and assay readout before modelling. Retrieval produced 115,232 raw records, reconciled into 72,148 merged records and 50,977 curated measurements across 19,585 compounds. Contents: row-level curated development and external measurements with the scaffold-split assignments; frozen curated-wide matrices at low, mid and high stratification resolution and for the fully pooled baseline; the versioned pharmacology and assay-readout ontology; per-endpoint external validation metrics and the pooled versus stratified comparison reported in the article; the locked expected outputs from the production run; and a reference implementation of model training and scaffold-locked external validation. Curated records derive from ChEMBL, BindingDB, PubChem and the IUPHAR/BPS Guide to Pharmacology.
